name: Urotsukidouji
source:
Based on original manga "Choujin Densetsu Urotsukidouji".
The game generally follows the main plot: the demon Amano Jaaku is banished from Makai (the demon world) to the Earth by the Elder, doomed to be trapped in a human body; he is given the mission of finding Choujin, the most powerful god, who is hiding in the body of a high-school student.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/urotsukidji]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
改编自原作漫画《超人传说乌月童子》。
游戏大致遵循以下主要情节：恶魔天野贾库被长老从魔界（恶魔世界）放​​逐到地球，注定被困在人类的身体里；他的使命是寻找隐藏在高中生体内的最强大的神Choujin。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/urotsukidji]Moby Games[/url]]
